purpose: Cross-product acceptance specification. These are test recipes, not results.

cases.trigger: Submit an invalid successor while a valid turn is running
cases.expect: Invalid successor rejected without cancelling valid predecessor

cases.trigger: Submit the same approval concurrently from two clients
cases.expect: One decision and at most one intended effect; consistent receipt on both clients

cases.trigger: Change tool arguments after approval request
cases.expect: Old approval cannot authorize new argument digest

cases.trigger: Disconnect after event k and reconnect with cursor k
cases.expect: No event loss; duplicate delivery harmless; no repeated model run

cases.trigger: Kill worker after external effect before receipt persistence
cases.expect: Unknown effect reconciled or escalated; never blindly retried

cases.trigger: Two workers race after an expired lease
cases.expect: Fencing or equivalent prevents both owning the same active execution

cases.trigger: Cancel parent while child awaits MCP and another child awaits approval
cases.expect: All descendants settle; blocked waiters wake; final state recorded

cases.trigger: Necessary tool omitted from initial prompt
cases.expect: Discovery loads exact permitted schema; audit records selection and resolution

cases.trigger: Deferred tool search returns no match
cases.expect: Explicit bounded fallback; no fabricated call or unbounded schema dump

cases.trigger: Generated code calls an unapproved destructive tool
cases.expect: Same policy gate as ordinary call; no bypass through code transport

cases.trigger: Code loops forever or emits unlimited output
cases.expect: Time CPU memory and output quotas terminate execution with diagnostic receipt

cases.trigger: Parallel tools return oversized responses then server restarts
cases.expect: Original results readable by authorized owner with integrity metadata

cases.trigger: Other tenant requests a guessed artifact ID or encoded traversal path
cases.expect: Denied without metadata or file disclosure

cases.trigger: Compact with unresolved approval and important earlier constraints
cases.expect: Approval identity constraints objective and source references survive

cases.trigger: Task needs detail omitted by compaction
cases.expect: Original evidence reacquired; reacquisition cost recorded

cases.trigger: Host sandbox unavailable or unsupported
cases.expect: Clear unavailable result; no silent privileged host fallback

cases.trigger: Sandbox removed externally during session
cases.expect: Explicit restore/recreate policy; no false claim that files survived

cases.trigger: OAuth token expires mid-task and user reauthorizes
cases.expect: Bounded retry and consistent continuation; credentials never enter model context

cases.trigger: Connector publishes paginated tools and changes a schema
cases.expect: Full bounded discovery and version-aware cache invalidation

cases.trigger: External application installs package in clean CJS and ESM projects
cases.expect: Typed session turn stream approval cancellation artifact flow works with declared peers

cases.trigger: Embed two sessions in an existing application
cases.expect: Style routing auth and session state remain isolated and accessible

cases.trigger: OIDC expired token wrong audience callback replay and forbidden email
cases.expect: Each invalid identity rejected; valid mapped identity receives correct permissions

cases.trigger: Unattended job uses revoked or insufficiently scoped credential
cases.expect: Denied per scope; revocation takes effect within documented bound

cases.trigger: DST boundary missed schedule and duplicate scheduler delivery
cases.expect: Documented timezone misfire and deduplication policy enforced

cases.trigger: Git skill branch changes after install
cases.expect: Pinned revision remains active until verified update; rollback restores prior artifact

cases.trigger: Refiner proposes tool skill with invalid schema
cases.expect: Candidate rejected before availability; active harness unchanged

cases.trigger: Candidate succeeds on source task but fails held-out tasks
cases.expect: No promotion based solely on source success; comparison evidence preserved

cases.trigger: Promoted candidate regresses after dependency update
cases.expect: Applicability rechecked and candidate reverted or disabled with trace

cases.trigger: Agent repeats identical non-progressing state and action
cases.expect: Bounded escalation or stop independently of model self-reflection

cases.trigger: Two refiners update same parent version concurrently
cases.expect: Version check rejects or safely rebases stale patch; no lost update

cases.trigger: Parallel children and reviewer consume remaining shared budget
cases.expect: Reservations prevent uncontrolled overspend; actual usage reconciled

cases.trigger: Failed paid attempt followed by success or all attempts fail
cases.expect: All known costs included; unknown cost reported as unknown instead of zero

cases.trigger: Missing matrix cell or stale judge verdict
cases.expect: Incomplete report and no denominator reduction or stale pass

cases.trigger: Import TrueForge project with unsupported resource and external credentials
cases.expect: Preview supported mapping and losses; credentials reauthorized; no silent omission

cases.trigger: Clean install upgrade backup restore and uninstall on target platform
cases.expect: Reproducible documented lifecycle; preserved user data according to explicit choice

cases.trigger: Edit retry branch export or share session through documented surface
cases.expect: Supported semantics mapped explicitly; unavailable operations remain open gaps
